notes: Minimap: new players are no longer told an operator reset their map; only players whose destination or marked spots were actually cleared get that message.
Story: when a quest step is too long for the quest box, its name is shortened and the direction, distance or time left always stays visible.
Land Claims: your own pets now work in other people's claims too. Pets tamed before this update stay locked in others' claims.
Kitchen: old dishes from before the Dish: line now stack with new servings once they are in your inventory or when you join.
Expeditions: the line for a dungeon now survives a reload or a restart, and after a restart you have 5 minutes to come back and keep your place.
Milestones: top-tier titles you missed while Titles & Trails was off are now sent again until Titles confirms them.
Realm Mail: a pack letter refused because the realm's mail is full no longer deletes your oldest letters.
Welcome Message: operators can restore or delete an old welcome the new default replaced (/realm:welcome -> Old welcome), and the welcome names Old Tobin or Mara only once they stand in town.
Many packs spread their per-second work over the second, so a full server runs smoother.
